name: Dime Commercial Bancshares, Inc.
summary: Dime Commercial Bancshares, Inc. operates as the holding company for Dime Community Bank that engages in the provision of various commercial banking and financial services in the United Stated. The company accepts time, savings, and demand deposits from the businesses, consumers, and local municipalities. It also provides commercial real estate loans; multi-family mortgage loans; residential mortgage loans; letters of credit; secured and unsecured commercial and consumer loans; lines of credit; home equity loans; and construction and land loans.
